motivation: Actual spatial integration shows retained basin weights violate the screening-mask collection areas even at low reference. Test alternatives determined solely by geology, never residuals.
geological_power_allocation: normalize unscaled independently integrated>=1Ma background-flank power across six regions; do not normalize its global integral to previous reference; positive/donor routing remains paired
geological_area_allocation: normalize eligible>=1Ma collection areas; geometry-only comparison, not uniform observed heat flux
retained_allocation: retain and report failed geometry, not silently replace as if already validated
spatial_witness_rule: Use primary S2_P3+geological_power maximum1955–2023B complete history; fixed criterion, not residual fit. If no feasible history, no source map. Native A remains independent, not a joint spatial attribution.
limitations: These are collection-area tests under40mW/m2ordinarydensity and exhaustive eligibility/nonoverlap assumptions. Per-basin young/old inventory and hydraulic connectivity not independently established. No temporal power increments from static grids.
